bin/watchexec.reason: Conductor's frontend runs spotlight through watchexec (CONDUCTOR_INT_WATCHEXEC_PATH, bundled-bin.json); OpenConductor watches natively (src-tauri/src/spotlight/watch.rs, run by `openconductor --tool spotlighter`). Conductor's copy is also not the upstream v2.3.2 release binary (sha256 differs), so it cannot be fetched pinned the way bin/gh is.

bin/conductor.reason: Shim that execs `.internal/conductor-runtime cli`, Conductor's agent-facing CLI. OpenConductor has no CLI counterpart yet.

bin/.internal/conductor-runtime.reason: Bun single-file executable (76 MB) that hosts the agent sidecar (bundled @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk) plus the logger, actions, internal and cli subcommands. OpenConductor runs agents from Rust instead: agent/claude_cli.rs launches Claude Code and agent/codex_cli.rs launches Codex. Conductor resolves its conductor-skill resource and hands it to the sidecar in CONDUCTOR_INTERNAL_SKILL_PLUGIN_DIR; OpenConductor passes the same resource to Claude Code with --plugin-dir.

bin/.internal/sidecar.reason: Shim for `conductor-runtime sidecar`, the agent runtime; replaced as bin/.internal/conductor-runtime is.

bin/.internal/logger.reason: Shim for `conductor-runtime logger`. The main binary configures it with CONDUCTOR_APP_LOGGER_* and CONDUCTOR_HONEYCOMB_* variables and per-environment Honeycomb ingest keys: it forwards app logs to Conductor's Honeycomb telemetry. OpenConductor sends no telemetry to Conductor's backend.

bin/.internal/actions.reason: Shim for `conductor-runtime actions`. The main binary starts the app actions server only for Conductor's internal users and refuses it otherwise, so it is a staff-only tool.

bin/.internal/agent-launcher.reason: 68 KB native launcher: `agent-launcher <executable> [arguments...]` replaces itself (posix_spawn with the set-exec flag) with the agent after responsibility_spawnattrs_setdisclaim, so macOS attributes privacy permission prompts to the agent rather than to the app. OpenConductor launches agents directly, so their prompts are attributed to OpenConductor.

UserNotifications.reason: Conductor drives UNUserNotificationCenter itself through objc2-user-notifications (17 symbols): it requests authorization, sets its own NotificationCenterDelegate class as the delegate, posts UNNotificationRequests with a title, body and userInfo, and reads a clicked notification's actionIdentifier (imports UNNotificationDefaultActionIdentifier) and userInfo, so it reacts to clicks on its notifications. OpenConductor posts notifications only through tauri-plugin-notification and does not link UserNotifications or handle clicks. What Conductor does on a click is not established.
